speaker: Narrator
text: The astronaut landed safely on the Moon and touched down on the ground. They met with the assistance of the communication device, Oberion.

speaker: Oberion
text: Greetings, human. Before you start your mission, you will have a short assessment for you to understand the missions.

speaker: Oberion
text: Oh, Nova. There you are! This is Nova, and they will be assisting you with the mission. You can count on Nova to evaluate your skills and guide you to your next objectives.

speaker: Oberion
text: Now, shall we proceed with your assessment?

speaker: Narrator
text: Upon arriving at the landing bay, the Astronaut quickly spotted the equipment they needed for their mission.

speaker: Operator
text: Let’s go pack our stuff, Nova. This way, we can head to our next mission.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Astronaut asked and glared at Nova. The figure nodded as it double-checked their bag once again.

speaker: Nova
text: Perfect! Everything is complete. We can now proceed to the ship!

speaker: Narrator
text: As they boarded the ship, the lights flared up to reveal buttons of many different colors.

speaker: Operator
text: Buckle up, Nova! We are going to the next planet!

speaker: Narrator
text: But before the Astronaut activated the engine, a warning sound emitted from the system’s window.

speaker: System
text: Error! Warning! Fuel insufficient for interplanetary travel!
